ARTIFICIAL_NEW.description: Just-created due current-near candidate with fresh movement evidence; no prior full CORE

reasoning: Existing row survives next discovery because !queue[row.id] is false even with !near and !active. Its current near fields are updated to0; termination is not undone, active staysfalse.
selectAutomatic admits both due rows using only canonical/source scope; current prequeue reason is not rechecked.

Unchanged score formula ranks ended120 above new20. An otherwise fresh new row has at most60 bounded quality/proximity/freshness bonus, so a sufficiently large age gap can dominate without any current growth evidence.

Given one available candidate ticket and no earlier manual/executor/global budget refusal, checkInstrument issues that ticket to the ended row before fresh deep facts. A cheap refusal does not refund the place.

This is not proof that overview0 means no exact possible growth: TZ201 says broad snapshots are preliminary. The defect is asymmetric indefinite operational eligibility merely because this asset was once queued, unlike an otherwise identical never-queued row.

After a completed analysis last_checked resets, so age itself does not prove permanent monopoly by one coin. A backlog of M unreviewed ended rows can conditionally consume M available places before a new candidate. Actual queue ordering/bank spend not observed by BA.
